ohtani.title: Kevin McGonigle hits a walk-off single in Tigers' win
ohtani.blurb: Kevin McGonigle walks it off in the 9th inning with a single, securing the Tigers' 2-1 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Craig Counsell recaps the Cubs' 19-2 win
imanaga.blurb: Craig Counsell talks about the Cubs drawing nine walks, Aaron Civale's performance out of the bullpen and more following the Cubs' 19-2 win

suzuki.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits THREE homers in Cubs' win
suzuki.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong adds to his MVP campaign with his first career three-homer game in the Cubs' 17-5 win over the Reds\n

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: José Soriano, Alejandro Kirk lead Toronto to 4-3 win
okamoto.blurb: José Soriano strikes out six over seven innings and Alejandro Kirk knocks in the go-ahead run to lead the Blue Jays to a 4-3 win

murakami.title: Andrew Benintendi powers White Sox to 3-2 win
murakami.blurb: Andrew Benintendi drives a solo home run plus an RBI single to power the White Sox in their 3-2 win over the Twins

matsui.title: Rays plate four in 7th to fuel 7-6 win over Padres
matsui.blurb: The Rays score four runs in the 7th while Jonathan Aranda and Junior Caminero added home runs in the team's 7-6 win over the Padres\n
